L1 read of #36867 against card #36110, built under maintainer ruling 7064241116 pt 1 on #35955 (claim 7121906996). Head `c58f24f85fe639b1d1b5ede4c3b1299666c0c737`; dev report 7123598244.

**Face.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36867` FLAGGED one item: `changeset`. Everything else is ok. At this head: 46 checks succeed, 11 skip as expected, 0 fail. `mergeable_state` clean. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**Read and sound.**
- The sign-out tier alone gains the keep: `purgeSignedOutUserClientState` passes `isKeptListLayoutEntry` to the `localStorage` sweep only. `sessionStorage` and `purgePreviousUserClientState` are unchanged, so a different person still clears everything. That is the ruling as stated: "a different person signing in on that browser still clears everything".
- Each entry is kept by prefix and by value shape. `list-layout:` holds `{ viewOrder?: string[], perView?: { id: { widths?: {field: finite number}, rowHeight?: one of 5 } } }`, and `grid-columns-` holds `{ order?: string[], widths?: {…} }`. Any other key, a wrong type, or a parse failure means the entry is not kept. That meets card item 2: "a test pins what may live under the kept keys". The app-shell pin fills both families through the real writers (`useObjectListLayout`, `ObjectGrid` resize and reorder) and signs out on all three paths (`signOut()`, a no-session read, and a 401 re-check), then checks that the same person keeps the layout and the next person loses it. Ablation 1 (keep dropped from the sweep) turns 13 pins red. No `anon` key spelling.
- Card item 3 is in: the `identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` item at rev 4 (title, acceptance[0], new acceptance[1] and negative[2], history row) and the `@object-ui/auth` README sign-out section. I checked both line by line against the code.
- The changeset prose matches the diff sentence by sentence.

**Finding.**
- **M1.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridColumnState.ts` is touched: the column-state comment gains the purge note. `@object-ui/plugin-grid` is published (no `private`; `files` ships `dist`), and the changeset lists only `@object-ui/auth`. The checklist rule for every touched published package is that it carries a changeset entry, judged by publication and not by the size of the change; I applied it the same way on #36811 today. (`@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so `listLayoutStore.ts` owes nothing.) **Fix:** add `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': patch` to `.changeset/36110-signout-keeps-list-layout.md`. The body already names that package's `grid-columns-` family, so nothing else changes.

Notes (nit, no action required):
- N1. The PR body's Tests line describes head 536d22791c and leaves out the `isPlainRecord` → `isLayoutObject` rename at c58f24f8. The report carries the readings at this head. Re-pinning the body would keep a reader from chasing the old sha.
- N2. `grid-columns-OBJECT[-VIEW]` names no user. Only the kept session-user pointer and the next sign-in's previous-user purge separate one person's grid widths from the next person's. That is the existing mechanism and is pinned here, so this is recorded only for whoever next touches the pointer.
- N3. The local `check:platform-checklist` exit 1 is red on origin/main too (anchor `anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals` in `access-security.json`). It is not this PR's, and ux-B is routing it to the seat.

Delta read owed on the head that carries M1: a paper read of the frontmatter, with the face re-run.
